power.method: PoE (IEEE 802.3bt Type 4, Class 8, 90W), 24 VAC or 36 VDC

storage.notes: SD card slot (SDHC/SDXC); Bosch does not recommend microSD cards or adapters. Capacity not stated.

features: Starlight imaging, HDR 120 dB (92 dB per IEC 62676-5)
Integrated IR (850 nm and 940 nm), 300 m detection, wide/medium/narrow beams
IVA Pro Buildings and IVA Pro Perimeter pre-installed
Pan 360 continuous, tilt -90 to 20, up to 400/300 deg per s
Remote Portal / Genetec Stratocast cloud services
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (NDP_7602_Z40L_Data_sheet_enUS_103590454411.pdf). IP66 pendant model with IR; the datasheet ordering text marks it "NDAA compliant" (ndaa_compliant left unset per project convention). Power 66.6 W max at 36 VDC (64.8 W PoE, 53 W at 24 VAC).

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.
